title: Can not load the pck that packed by PCKPacker
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot_v4.5-beta2_win64

### System information

Window11 -Godot_v4.5-beta2 -Vulkan(Mobile) -Geforce 4080Super

### Issue description

I was tring script a custom plugin to help package my project.
I used PCKPacker to pack every folder in my project, and everything is ok.
When i tried to load the pcks via ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack() function, i can not load any pcks.
Here is Pack script:
```
	for folder in folders_to_pack:
		var pack_name = folder + ".pck"
		var source_pack_path = "res://" + folder
		print("Start Package Folder: ", pack_name, " -> ", output_folder_path)
		var rp = PCKPacker.new()
		var error
		var ctx = HashingContext.new()
		ctx.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
		error = rp.pck_start(output_folder_path + pack_name)
		if error != 0:
			print(error_string(error))
			return
		print("Create new PCK:" + output_folder_path.path_join(pack_name))
		await _add_folder_to_pack(source_pack_path, rp, ctx)
		var save_err = rp.flush()
		if save_err != OK:
			await get_tree().create_timer(3).timeout
			print("Pack failed!")
		var res = ctx.finish()
		if save_err != OK:
			push_error("Pack Failed: " + output_folder_path + pack_name)
			continue
```

( this is the function add file into pck )

```
func _add_folder_to_pack(folder_path: String, rp: PCKPacker, ctx = HashingContext) -> void:
	var _dir = DirAccess.open(folder_path)
	print("open folder:"+folder_path)
	if _dir == null:
		print("Failed open:"+folder_path)
		return
	_dir.list_dir_begin()
	var file_name = _dir.get_next()
	while file_name != "":
		if _dir.current_is_dir():
			print("Start Pack Sub Folder:" + folder_path.path_join(file_name))
			await _add_folder_to_pack(folder_path.path_join(file_name), rp)
		else:
			if not FileAccess.file_exists(folder_path.path_join(file_name)):
				print("file does not exist"+folder_path.path_join(file_name))
				return
			#if file_name.ends_with(".import") or file_name.ends_with(".gd.uid") or file_name.ends_with(".tmp"):
				#print("ignore import file:"+folder_path.path_join(file_name))
			else:
				print("Packing File:" + folder_path.path_join(file_name))
				print(file_name)
				hash_file(folder_path.path_join(file_name), ctx)
				var error = rp.add_file(folder_path.path_join(file_name), folder_path.path_join(file_name))
				print(error_string(error))
		file_name = _dir.get_next()
		await get_tree().process_frame
	_dir.list_dir_end()
```

(this is the function i used try to load every pck file. i try local_file path with "res://" but still failed load pcks )
```
	for _name in _load_info:
		print(_load_info[_name]["file"])
		loaded = ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack(local_file_path + _load_info[_name]["file"],true)
		if loaded:
			await update_hot_update_progress( _name + " loaded",progress_delay_time)
			_load_info.erase(_name)
		else:
			print(local_file_path + _load_info[_name]["file"])
			print("load failed")
```


### Steps to reproduce

1.pack every folder as a pck
2.use ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack to load pcks
